# The Bharath News — Complete Documentation

## Overview

The Bharath News (https://www.thebharathnews.com) is a multilingual AI-powered news aggregation platform. We source articles from leading news publishers across India and the GCC region, curate them using AI-assisted classification, and deliver them to readers in their preferred language.

## Content Structure

### Article Schema
Each article contains:
- Title (headline)
- Summary (2-3 sentence overview)
- Full content (complete article body)
- Category (india, gcc, business, technology, sports, entertainment, health, education, jobs, realestate, world, lifestyle, opinion)
- Language (en, hi, ml, ta, kn, te, bn)
- Published date
- Source attribution
- Featured image
- URL slug for canonical linking

### Categories with Descriptions

1. **India** (/india) — Domestic news covering politics, governance, economy, infrastructure, social issues, and significant events across Indian states.

2. **GCC** (/gcc) — News from Gulf Cooperation Council countries including UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Oman. Focus on Indian diaspora, labor, business, and regional developments.

3. **Business** (/business) — Corporate news, stock markets (NSE/BSE), economic policy, startups, banking, and financial markets.

4. **Technology** (/technology) — Tech industry updates, AI/ML developments, smartphone launches, startup ecosystem, digital policy, and cybersecurity.

5. **Sports** (/sports) — Cricket (IPL, international), football, hockey, Olympics, tennis, and other sports.

6. **Entertainment** (/entertainment) — Bollywood, regional cinema (Tollywood, Mollywood, Kollywood, Sandalwood), OTT content, music, celebrities.

7. **Health & Wellness** (/health) — Medical research, public health, fitness, nutrition, mental health, and healthcare policy.

8. **Education** (/education) — Competitive exams (JEE, NEET, UPSC), university admissions, scholarship programs, education policy (NEP).

9. **Jobs & Careers** (/jobs) — Government job notifications, private sector hiring, career guidance, and skill development.

10. **Real Estate** (/real-estate) — Property markets across Indian cities, RERA regulations, housing trends, commercial real estate.

11. **World** (/world) — International affairs, geopolitics, diplomacy, global economy, and climate.

12. **Lifestyle & Travel** (/lifestyle) — Travel destinations, food culture, fashion, wellness retreats, festivals.

13. **Opinion** (/opinion) — Analysis, editorials, expert commentary on current affairs.

### Languages Supported

| Code | Language | Script | Primary Audience |
|------|----------|--------|------------------|
| en | English | Latin | Pan-India, International, NRI globally |
| hi | Hindi | Devanagari | North India, National audience |
| ml | Malayalam | Malayalam | Kerala, Gulf Malayali diaspora (UAE, Saudi, Qatar) |
| ta | Tamil | Tamil | Tamil Nadu, Sri Lanka, Singapore, Malaysia |
| kn | Kannada | Kannada | Karnataka, Bengaluru tech community |
| te | Telugu | Telugu | Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, US Telugu diaspora |
| bn | Bengali | Bengali | West Bengal, Bangladesh border |
| ur | Urdu | Nastaliq | Urdu-speaking communities across India |

## URL Structure

- Homepage: https://www.thebharathnews.com
- Category: https://www.thebharathnews.com/{category}
- Article: https://www.thebharathnews.com/article/{slug}
- Videos: https://www.thebharathnews.com/videos
- Search: https://www.thebharathnews.com/search?q={query}
- Explore: https://www.thebharathnews.com/explore

## Publishing

Articles are published continuously throughout the day (every 15 minutes), sourced from verified RSS feeds of established news publishers including BBC India, NDTV, The Hindu, Times of India, Economic Times, OneIndia, Google News India, and regional publishers. Content is classified and quality-scored using AI before publication.

## RSS Feeds for Programmatic Access

- All languages: https://www.thebharathnews.com/feed.xml
- Malayalam only: https://www.thebharathnews.com/feed.xml?lang=ml

GCC/Gulf: Indian workers in Gulf, kafala system, Iqama rules, UAE golden visa, Saudi Vision 2030, expo Dubai, Indian schools Gulf, remittance to India, Indian restaurants Gulf, Indian associations UAE
